title: Chốt UX/scope và đề
acceptance: Product scope, wireframe states; xác nhận flow/FAQ với B/C

title: Contract freeze + repo/infra spike
acceptance: Schema/fixture và port được 3 người duyệt; repo CI skeleton, public account/billing

title: Model/provider spike
acceptance: 3 text + 3 ảnh synthetic; pin model ID, quota/privacy/latency, structured JSON

title: Extension capture + preview
acceptance: MV3 action, activeTab, HTTP(S) capture/crop/consent, paste fallback; không gửi ngầm

title: FastAPI + Docker + public health
acceptance: Docker clean build, GET health public HTTPS, validation/fixture local, CI smoke

title: Vision engine + schema
acceptance: Text/image inference; prompt injection isolation, valid assessment and unit mock

title: Extension result + web demo
acceptance: Same adapter; web upload/paste/fixture, both render all enums/errors, consent

title: Real analyze integration
acceptance: Wire provider, body/image validation, timeout, no-store; deploy real end-to-end

title: Fallback & dev fixture set
acceptance: UNKNOWN fallback, safe actions, 12 dev fixtures + lexical baseline; record real test

title: External UI E2E and polish
acceptance: Fresh Chrome, public web, capture consent network check, states keyboard/mobile web

title: Security + integration gate
acceptance: Rate/concurrency, no logs, invalid/oversize, 429/timeouts, production rejects mock; all P0 smoke

title: Adversarial QA + holdout lock
acceptance: 30 labeled cases stratified dev/holdout; independent labels, adversarial failures, prompt freeze

title: Demo UX & slide/guide drafts
acceptance: Guide URL/steps, 8 slide outline, fixture flows; fix P0 UI only

title: Release hardening + README
acceptance: Clean build/CI, download extension with final API host, actual external smoke and README declarations

title: Holdout evaluation + claims
acceptance: AI vs baseline same holdout, counts/precision/recall/FP/unknown/latency; limitations evidence

title: Finalize guide/slides + UI freeze
acceptance: A4 1 page, slide PDF ≤10 pages with actual metrics, reviewed public URL

title: Freeze release and source ZIP
acceptance: Tagged tested commit + image digest, ZIP checksum, README, clean unzip/run; retain hosting

title: Record final demo MP4
acceptance: ≤3 min running real release candidate; no personal data; actual results/limitations

title: Independent guide test
acceptance: Guide-only fresh machine test, confirm PDF pages/links, sign off

title: Final submission & runbook
acceptance: Leader submits all files before 18:00 ICT; capture receipt, hashes, maintain to 11/12

title: Final AI/video verification
acceptance: Validate MP4 duration, live AI text/image, model/quota until 11/12, sign off
